# FustAI Mobile Link

Connects the FustAI mobile app with this computer so your conversations continue here. The computer must stay running and online.

## How it works

1. Sign in to the same FustAI account on both the computer and the phone.
2. Enable this plugin on the computer; at startup it registers this host with your FustAI account automatically.
3. In the mobile app's run location, pick this computer and continue the conversation.

## Notes

- When the computer is offline, the phone simply shows it as offline; no server address or pairing code is entered.
- Sessions, workspaces, and files stay on this computer. Devices connect peer to peer with end-to-end encryption and fall back to a relay that cannot decrypt the traffic.
- The phone can also run on its own without connecting to a computer.
